pictures.name: AR1-The-Road-To-Ars
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. February 1818, the flat farmland of eastern France in thick winter fog: a young priest of thirty-two, thin, with a pale gentle face, kind deep-set eyes and dark hair falling to his collar, in a worn black cassock and a black broad-brimmed hat, walks a muddy country lane beside a farm cart carrying his few belongings. Beside him a shepherd boy of about ten in a brown wool coat and clogs, with a few sheep, points ahead through the mist to the faint shape of a small village church spire. Pale gold light breaking through the fog. The priest and the boy in the middle. Hopeful, humble, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: AR2-Empty-Church
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold candlelight. Before dawn inside a small, plain, nearly empty French village church of the early 1800s: bare stone walls, a few rough wooden benches, one candle burning on a simple altar and a small red sanctuary lamp. The young priest (thin, pale gentle face, kind deep-set eyes, dark hair falling to his collar, worn black cassock) kneels alone on the stone floor before the altar, hands folded, head bowed. Deep blue darkness all around, gold candlelight on his face and hands. The priest in the middle. Lonely, faithful, still. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: AR3-The-Line
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Night outside a small stone village church in 1840s France: a long line of people wraps around the church walls and down the lane, waiting patiently by lantern light. Farm women in shawls and white caps, an elegant lady in a dark silk cloak, an old man leaning on a stick, a young man with his hat in his hands looking anxious. The church door stands open, warm gold light spilling out onto the cobbles. Stars and deep blue sky above. The open glowing door in the middle. Patient, hopeful, hushed. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: AR4-The-Box
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Inside a small French village church, a cramped, plain dark-wood confessional box. Inside it sits the Curé of Ars in his later years, an old priest about sixty, very thin and gaunt, with a pale gentle face, kind deep-set eyes and long white hair falling to his shoulders, in a black cassock with a white surplice and a purple stole, wrapped against the cold, his head bent close to the small wooden lattice, listening with total attention. Through the lattice, only the faint outline of a kneeling person, face unseen. Pale winter light from a high window, deep blue shadows, one candle. The priest in the middle. Tender, patient, tireless. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: AR6-Today-Confessional
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, lifelike faces, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, of a modern scene today: inside a quiet Catholic church on a Saturday afternoon, a carved dark-wood confessional with a heavy purple curtain half drawn and a small warm light glowing above its door. A woman in her thirties in a grey wool coat sits on the end of a pew nearby, holding a small folded scrap of paper in both hands, eyes closed, gathering her courage. Soft gold light through stained glass windows with no lettering. The woman and the confessional in the middle. Nervous, hopeful, gentle. No text, no letters, no logos.
